title: Grilled Kabanos Skewers with Croatian Bread
description: A simple skewer recipe featuring Croatian kabanos sausage, perfect for a quick weeknight meal. Serve with crusty Croatian bread for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: 2. Cut the kabanos sausage into 1-inch pieces.
3. Thread the sausage pieces onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. While the skewers are cooking, slice the Croatian bread into 1-inch thick slices.
7. Grill the bread slices for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
8. To serve, place a skewer on each plate and serve with a slice of grilled bread and a sprinkle of airy cheese.
